done.title: You're all set
done.replay: You can replay this tour any time from the profile menu or the Help page.

plan.free: You're on Free. Upgrade any time from Settings › Billing.
plan.active: You're on {{plan}}. Everything it includes is unlocked.

candidate.welcomeText: Here's how to get from a new account to your first application. We'll show you four places to start.
candidate.doneText: Start with your CV. AI uses it to fill in your profile and match you to the right jobs.

cv.title: Upload your CV
cv.summary: AI reads it and fills in your profile.
cv.text: Start here. Upload your resume once and AI fills in your profile, so recruiters see the full picture.
cv.pageText: Each upload becomes a version, and you decide which one recruiters see.

profile.title: Complete your profile
profile.summary: Complete profiles show up in recruiter searches.
profile.text: Recruiters search profiles, not files. Add your headline, skills and experience to appear in their results.
profile.pageText: Start with your headline and skills. The checklist on this page shows what is still missing.

jobs.title: Find matched jobs
jobs.text: Jobs are ranked against your profile and CV, so the best matches come first.
jobs.pageText: Search by title or skill, then narrow the list by city, work mode and salary.

applications.title: Track your applications
applications.text: Every application and its status in one place, from submitted to offer.
applications.pageText: Once you apply, each role shows up here with its stage and the recruiter's updates.

recruiter.welcomeText: Here's how to go from a new account to your first hire. We'll show you four places to start.
recruiter.doneText: Post your first job. Matched candidates and applications follow from there.

company.title: Set up your company page
company.text: Candidates check who is hiring. Add your logo, description and location to build trust.
company.pageText: Candidates see this on every job you post. Keep it complete and up to date.

jobs.title: Post your first job
jobs.text: Create a role with its skills, salary and location. Matched candidates follow.
jobs.pageText: Start here. You can save a draft and publish it when it's ready.

candidates.title: Find candidates
candidates.text: Search verified candidates by skill, city and availability, and invite the right ones to apply.
candidates.pageText: Use search and filters to narrow the list, then open a profile to see the details.

pipeline.title: Run your hiring pipeline
pipeline.text: Move applicants through your stages, from new to hired.
pipeline.pageText: Filter by job, and switch between the board and funnel views.
